scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.predev: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web
